# Telegram

> > Telegram is a cloud-based instant messaging platform enabling group chats, channels, and communities across diverse topics including Web3/blockchain, sports betting, and specialized interest groups.

Telegram serves as a messaging and community platform where users can join public groups and channels covering topics from cryptocurrency communities (Cardano, Bluwhale) to sports analytics (KHL, NHL, VHL hockey) and entertainment. The platform supports both public discovery and private group interactions with invite-based access.

## Key Topics

- Telegram Groups
- Telegram Channels
- Web3 & Blockchain
- Cardano
- Cryptocurrency Communities
- Sports Betting & Analytics
- Hockey (KHL, NHL, VHL)
- DApps
- Channel Invites
- Russian Content
- Community Discovery
- Digital Communication
